row.notes: Network bitstream: write float value (xmm1) in [min xmm2, max xmm3] quantised by precision (stack arg, e.g. 0.001); in typed mode (stream+0x29) writes type tags 0xf/0xd first; traces 'numerical space ... too large' and falls back to raw when range/precision overflows. Stream: +8 write buf, +0x1c size, +0x20 write bit pos, +0x28 error. Used by Game_NetworkTyres_TyreSetSerializeStart and vehicle serialisers. Addon: decode network packets.
